يحترمون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَرِمُونَ (yaḥtarimūna) /jaħ.ta.ri.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# يُحْتَرَمُونَ (yuḥtaramūna) /juħ.ta.ra.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
